# wrkpad
> Local-first tactile control plane for Creator Micro 2, Codex, Claude Code, and agentic engineering fleets.

- Repository: https://github.com/ashlrai/wrkpad
- Agent instructions: https://github.com/ashlrai/wrkpad/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- Architecture: https://github.com/ashlrai/wrkpad/blob/main/docs/architecture.md
- Security: https://github.com/ashlrai/wrkpad/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Controls: https://github.com/ashlrai/wrkpad/blob/main/app/docs/controls.md
- Setup: https://github.com/ashlrai/wrkpad/blob/main/app/docs/setup.md
- Release evidence: https://github.com/ashlrai/wrkpad/blob/main/docs/release.md
- Capabilities: capabilities.json

The core is MIT; the desktop app is Apache-2.0. This is a developer preview with no signed public binary. Device operation is observe-only. Provider approvals and release authority remain outside wrkpad. The landing demo is synthetic. An Amplify, Verify, Polish, and Advance delivery contract is proposed for Codex and Claude Code/cmux; the current landing does not claim that contract is released. It does not submit prompts or terminal input.
